description: A DOI on a data-repository prefix is the deposit that accompanies a paper — "Replication Data for: ..." — and carries the word replication into the pipeline without being a study (issue #141). The deposit is evidence that a replication exists, but the paper itself is in the corpus under its own DOI, so discarding the deposit loses nothing. figshare (10.6084) is a regex rather than a prefix entry because non_article_doi() matches it on the "10.6084/" boundary. EXCLUDE-ONLY and deliberately incomplete: a prefix belongs here only when its registrant is positively identified as a data repository, which is why Zenodo (10.5281) is absent — CODECHECK certificates live there and the reproduction arm admits them.

measured.rationale: Hand-check of the deposits these prefixes contributed; each prefix was separately confirmed against DataCite as belonging to a deposit-only registrant.
